{{Top|ga}} {{Character |type=Criminal |image=[[File:JothVer-BBH.png]] |name=Joth Ver |homeworld=[[Mimban]]{{DatapadCite|''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]''|BatuuBountyHunters-JothVer.png}} |birth= |death= |species=[[Human]] |gender= |pronouns= |height= |mass= |hair= |feathers= |eyes= |skin= |cyber= |families= |parents= |partners= |siblings= |children= |affiliation=[[Spice Runners of Kijimi]]{{Film|IX}} |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Listen3|JothVer.flac|Joth Ver crying out|Joth Ver cries out when struck by Rey's quarterstaff}} '''Joth Ver''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi]] from the [[planet]] [[Mimban]] who had a [[bounty]] on their head during the [[First Order]] [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] of the planet [[Batuu]] in [[34 ABY]]. A visitor located Ver while the [[spicerunner]] was hiding in [[Black Spire Outpost]] on Batuu and reported the bounty's location to the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]]. In [[35 ABY]], Ver backed [[Zorii Bliss]], leader of the Spice Runners, when she confronted former spicerunner [[Poe Dameron]] in the streets of [[Kijimi City]] on the planet [[Kijimi]]. After Bliss ordered Ver and the other members of her crew to attack, Dameron's ally [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] defeated them with her [[Rey's quarterstaff|quarterstaff]]. Bliss then agreed to help Dameron, Rey, and their allies shortly before Kijimi was [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] by the [[Sith Eternal]]. ==Biography== {{Quote|You. You're the one they're looking for. Bounty for her just might cover us. ''Djak'kankah!"
"''Don't ''djak'kankah.|Zorii Bliss orders Joth Ver, Vibbo, and Vicii to attack Rey and her allies as Poe Dameron begs them not to|audio=Bliss-Djakkankah-TROS.flac|}} [[File:Bliss-Ver-TROS.png|thumb|right|300px|Joth Ver (left) served under Zorii Bliss (center) in the Spice Runners of Kijimi.]] Joth Ver was a [[human]] from the [[planet]]''[[Solo: A Star Wars Story The Official Guide]]'' [[Mimban]] who was one of the [[Spice Runners of Kijimi]] during the [[First Order-Resistance War]]. During the [[First Order]]'s [[Battle of Batuu|occupation]] of the planet [[Batuu]] in [[34 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of [[Star Wars: Galaxy's Edge|''Star Wars'': Galaxy's Edge]], including ''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]'', to [[34 ABY]]. Ver had an 8,600-[[Galactic Credit Standard|credit]] [[bounty]] on their head for [[Smuggler|smuggling]], property damage, evading arrest, and being a [[spicerunner]], with the posting warning that the target was [[Weapon|armed]] and dangerous and so should be approached with extreme caution. A visitor to [[Black Spire Outpost]] on Batuu was assigned Ver's bounty by the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild]], and using a [[thermal scanner]], the visitor located the spicerunner hiding in one of the buildings in the outpost. Ver's location was then reported to the local [[Guildmaster's Hideout]] so that the visitor could collect the reward. In [[35 ABY]],''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of {{Film|IX}} to [[35 ABY]]. Ver was in [[Kijimi City]] on the planet [[Kijimi]]''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'' during its [[Occupation of Kijimi|occupation]] by the First Order. Ver accompanied [[Zorii Bliss]], leader of the Spice Runners, and fellow members [[Vibbo]] and [[Vicii]],''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition]]'' to track down the former spicerunner [[Poe Dameron]] after Bliss learned that he had entered the [[city]]. Bliss got the drop on Dameron, who was now a member of the [[Resistance]], and held him and several of his Resistance allies at [[blaster]] point in one of the city's streets. Ver and the other spicerunners with Bliss slowly surrounded the Resistance members as Dameron tried to convince her to help him, but after recognizing the [[Jedi]] [[Rey Skywalker|Rey]] as the target of a First Order bounty, Bliss ordered her crew to attack. [[File:Rey-Ver-TROS.png|thumb|left|300px|Rey (center left) defeated Joth Ver (center right) and Zorii Bliss in Kijimi City.]] The Jedi knocked down Bliss and the other two spicerunners with her [[Rey's quarterstaff|quaterstaff]] before jabbing the [[Quarterstaff|staff]] into Ver's chest and knocking the last member of Bliss's crew standing back down a stairway. After Rey produced her [[Skywalker lightsaber|lightsaber]], Bliss agreed to help the Resistance and led Dameron and his allies off the streets without Ver and the others, leaving Vibbo and Vicii unconscious. The presence of the Resistance agents caused the First Order to lock down Kijimi City and begin rounding up its inhabitants for questioning so the spicerunners soon convened to plan their various routes to flee offworld. Bliss, Vicii, and at least some of the other spicerunners did successfully escape the planet,{{EncyclopediaCite|Din Djarin and Other Characters of the Underworld}} but those that could not were [[Death|killed]] by the First Order-aligned [[Knights of Ren]], and the gang was disbanded. The [[Sith Eternal]] then [[Destruction of Kijimi|destroyed]] Kijimi after the First Order had [[Protocol 13|evacuated]] its personnel. ==Equipment== Ver wore a [[Color|brown]] [[Hair|fur]] [[Cape|cloak]] over a red outfit with a brown [[bandolier]], a brown [[belt]], and a brown and red [[helmet]]. The spicerunner carried a [[blaster pistol]] in a [[holster]] and used a [[blaster rifle]] when attacking Rey. ==Behind the scenes== {{Quote|The image of Zorii and two of her henchmen was the only concept where we see her and her gang together.|Calum Alexander Watt|''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]''}} [[File:Zorii_Henchmen_Mood_Version_1B.png|thumb|right|300px|Zorii Henchmen Mood Version 1B]] Joth Ver first appeared in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']]. Concept art of Ver with Bliss and another henchman was drawn by costume concept artist [[Calum Alexander Watt]]. Titled "Zorii Henchmen Mood Version 1B," it was the only piece of concept art to show Bliss together with her crew. Ver was then identified in ''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]'', an augmented-reality [[Star Wars video games|video game]] launched at [[Wikipedia:Walt Disney World|Walt Disney World]] on [[July 27]], [[2022]].{{DPB|url=2022/07/magicbandplus-launching-july-27-at-walt-disney-world|text=MagicBand+ Launching July 27 at Walt Disney World|nolive=1}} The [[March 17]], [[2020]]{{PenguinRandomHouse|url=books/609082/the-rise-of-skywalker-expanded-edition-star-wars-by-rae-carson/9780593128404|text=The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition (Star Wars)}} [[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: Expanded Edition|novelization]] of ''The Rise of Skywalker'' by [[Rae Carson]] erroneously describes only two spicerunners—Vibbo and Vicii—attacking Rey with Bliss despite three being clearly visible in the film. The [[April 16]], 2020{{Amazon|domain=co.uk|url=Star-Wars-Skywalker-Junior-Novel/dp/1405296542|text=Star Wars The Rise of Skywalker Junior Novel}} [[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel|junior novelization]] of the film also only describes two [[Mercenary|mercenaries]] armed with [[pike]]s as assisting Bliss''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: A Junior Novel]]'' and the [[2021]] [[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Graphic Novel Adaptation|graphic novel]] illustrated by [[Cryssy Cheung]] only depicts two other spicerunners, neither of whom match the appearances[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker Graphic Novel Adaptation|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Graphic Novel Adaptation]] of the three spicerunners seen in the film. ==Appearances== *{{DatapadCite|''[[Star Wars: Batuu Bounty Hunters]]''|BatuuBountyHunters-JothVer.png}} {{1stID|Joth Ver}} *{{Film|IX}} {{1st}} *[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker (Screen Comix)|''Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker'' Screen Comix]] ==Sources== {{Mediacat|imagecat=Images of Joth Ver|soundcat=Audio files of Joth Ver}} *''[[The Art of Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker]]'' ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{DEFAULTSORT:Ver, Joth}} [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with unspecified pronouns]] [[Category:Members of the Spice Runners of Kijimi]] [[Category:Smugglers]]
